imported_work.note: The command records evidence and boundaries only; existing work is not promoted into an editorial or release state.

preservation_constraints.constraint: Read and hash existing content, brand, media, routes, and rendered evidence only; do not overwrite, delete, or rewrite these paths.
Preserve existing studio files and event history; only missing initializer artifacts, a new immutable adoption record, the current pointer, and one appended event may be written.
Imported work remains unknown until current editorial, evidence, accessibility, rights, and release gates establish its state.
Use the inventory as an upgrade baseline for current contracts; do not add compatibility shims or retain deprecated patterns without an explicit requirement.
